problemFound.summary: The existing MainCamera pre-cull solar guard protected the direct-light/shadow state of the still, and the reflection awaiter proved RenderID completion, but the two mechanisms did not cryptographically bind the asynchronous realtime cubemap illumination to the still illumination. A persistently changed sun, procedural sky, ambient SH or global shadow/LOD state during the probe-render interval could therefore create a completed but lighting-incoherent cubemap.

hashedState: exact sole SummerSun rotation/forward vector, intensity, color temperature/color, shadow mode/resolution/strength/bias/normal bias/near plane and culling mask
procedural-sky asset path/GUID/shader plus sun disk, sun size, convergence, atmosphere, sky tint, ground color and exposure properties
RenderSettings ambient mode/intensity, default reflection mode/resolution/intensity/bounces/custom-reflection presence, fog mode/color/start/end
QualitySettings realtime reflection probes, shadow projection/quality/resolution/distance/cascades/splits/near-plane, MSAA, LOD bias, maximum LOD and anisotropic filtering

probeCompletionStillRequires: fresh async proof SHA-256-bound to current reflection completion receipt

implementation.native4kPacket: The complete native-4K packet now validates the solar/shadow contract before reflection synchronization and again before still/temporal evidence. The async wait proof itself recomputes the physical-lighting hash immediately before still acceptance.

selfAudit.finding: Initial implementation compared only request and completion hashes.
selfAudit.correction: Strengthened the awaiter to recompute the complete lighting fingerprint on every observed EditorApplication.update while probe RenderIDs are in flight; the wait proof requires lightingFingerprintPollCount == editorPollCount.

selfAudit.finding: Initial fingerprint omitted per-light shadow resolution and global maximumLODLevel/anisotropicFiltering even though the contract described complete shadow/LOD coherence.
selfAudit.correction: Added sun.shadowResolution, sun.cullingMask, QualitySettings.maximumLODLevel and QualitySettings.anisotropicFiltering before recording the run.

selfAudit.finding: A mutation that begins and fully reverts entirely between observable Editor callbacks cannot be proven absent by source-only polling.
selfAudit.correction: Recorded this as a runtime-verification limitation instead of claiming absolute render coherence; actual Unity execution remains mandatory.

verification.verificationLimit: Source/static verification cannot prove Unity API compilation, ambient-SH stabilization timing, actual probe-camera illumination, native still pixels, Fresnel/reflection direction, shadow contact or temporal stability.

expectedVisualScoreImpactAfterRealRender.lightingShadowsReflections: Potentially reduces stale/incoherent local-reflection deductions by ensuring the cubemap and still share one observed physical lighting state; no source-only points.
expectedVisualScoreImpactAfterRealRender.materialPbr: Makes glass/metal angular response review correspond to the same sky/sun/ambient state as the frame; no source-only points.
expectedVisualScoreImpactAfterRealRender.cinematicImage: Prevents local specular energy from silently belonging to an earlier environment state; no source-only points.
expectedVisualScoreImpactAfterRealRender.temporalLodAliasing: Includes MSAA/LOD/aniso state in the coherence hash, but actual shimmer/pop remains pixel evidence only.

nextBlocker.actionWhenAvailable: Immediately stop speculative expansion and run NewTown/QA/Prepare Complete Native 4K Review Packet in Unity 6000.3.0f1. If the first per-poll hash changes because RenderSettings.ambientProbe is still converging after DynamicGI.UpdateEnvironment, add an explicit environment-stability wait before RenderProbe rather than relaxing the hash. Once hashes remain invariant, inspect hero/oblique/grazing 3840x2160 frames and 100% crops for reflection direction, direct-vs-specular light coherence, glass/metal Fresnel, contact shadows and light leaks; then inspect temporal evidence for cascade/LOD/specular shimmer. Fix any critical pixel defect before scoring.
